verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              आसीद्धर्मस्य गोप्ता वै पूर्वमत्रिसमः प्रभुः। अत्रिवंशसमुत्पन्नस्त्वङ्गो नाम प्रजापतिः॥१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: न स शोचेत्कृताकृतैरिति। मया पापं कृतं धर्मो न कृत इति पश्चात्तापेन न शोचेत्। एतच्छ्रवणं सर्वपापनाशनं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदं चेत्यर्थः॥३४॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद्वेनो नात्यर्थं धर्मकोविदः। जातो मृत्युसुतायां वै सुनीथायां प्रजापतिः॥२॥
verses.english: There emerged a son to this अन्ग prajApati, named वेन, who is a selfmade philistine in the matters of dharma... this king वेन took birth from the daughter of Death, namely lady सुनीथ, and prajApati anga...

verses.sanskrit: स मातामहदोषेण वेनः कालात्मजात्मजः। स्वधर्मं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा कामाल्लोभेष्ववर्तत॥३॥
verses.english: "If I have a fancy, I will burn the earth, or deluge it in waters... or, immobilize earth and heaven... you need not treat it cavalierly..." So said vena to sages.

verses.sanskrit: मर्यादां स्थापयामास धर्मोपेतां स पार्थिवः। वेदधर्मानतिक्रम्य सोऽधर्मनिरतोऽभवत्॥४॥
verses.english: Relegating his own dharma rearwards king वेन indulged in acquisitiveness and tight-fistedness, owing to his deriving adversarial qualities of his maternal grandfather, namely the Death, because वेन is the son of the daughter of Timegod, namely यम...

verses.sanskrit: निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारास्तस्मिन्राजनि शासति। प्रवृत्तं न पपुः सोमं हुतं यज्ञेषु देवताः॥५॥
verses.english: On listening to various arguments of Mother Earth in the form of cow, that highminded pR^ithu restrained his anger and spoke to her in this way.

verses.sanskrit: न यष्टव्यं न होतव्यमिति तस्य प्रजापतेः। आसीत्प्रतिज्ञा क्रूरेयं विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते॥६॥
verses.english: "Oh, vena, no doubt, you have emerged in this dynasty of prajApati-s after the demise of atri, and you promised to rule the people righteously... and we for ourselves have entered a ritual vow that lasts for many long years... so, please do not embark on this Endeavour of altering the existing practice of vedic rituals aimed at gods... please do not change the age-old practice... " So said sages to king vena.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रवृतं देवतोद्देशेन त्यक्तं हुतम् अग्नौ प्रक्षिप्तमपि सोमं न पपुः यतो निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: अहमिज्यश्च यष्टा च यज्ञश्चेति कुरूद्वह। मयि यज्ञो विधातव्यो मयि होतव्यमित्यपि॥७॥
verses.english: Laughing at those great sages who are speaking thus, then the evil-minded vena spoke this to them, without knowing the meaning and fatality contained in the saying of sages.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्र हेतुमाह- नेति। धर्मद्वेष्टरि राज्ञि दत्तमपि हविर्देवा न भजन्त इति भावः॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: तमतिक्रान्तमर्यादमाददानमसाम्प्रतम्। ऊचुर्महर्षयः सर्वे मरीचिप्रमुखास्तदा॥८॥
verses.english: From then onwards, oh, janamejaya, whenever such praises of legitimization are to be heard, or blessings needed to be showered, then the eulogies sUtA-s and mAgadhA-s have come into vogue.
verses.bhavadeepa: मयि देवतारूपे मन्निमित्तं न त्वन्यदेवतार्थं मयि अग्निरूपे॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: वयं दीक्षां प्रवेक्ष्यामः संवत्सरगणान्बहून्। अधर्मं कुरु मा वेन नैष धर्मः सनातनः॥९॥
verses.english: "For all the living beings, as a matter of fact, for dharma itself I am the provenance... but, you sages are fatuous to know this owing to your half-wittedness...

verses.sanskrit: निधनेऽत्र प्रसूतस्त्वं प्रजापतिरसंशयम्। प्रजाश्च पालयिष्येऽहमिति ते समयः कृतः॥१०॥
verses.english: "If I have a fancy, I will burn the earth, or deluge it in waters... or, immobilize earth and heaven... you need not treat it cavalierly..." So said vena to sages.

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तदा ब्रुवतः सर्वान्महर्षीनब्रवीत्तदा। वेनः प्रहस्य दुर्बुद्धिरिममर्थमनर्थवित्॥११॥
verses.english: And you may know that others called तुषारा-स्, तुम्बुरा-s, who took delight in अधर्म and whose abode is vindhya range, have also emerged as the posterity of vena.

verses.sanskrit:
वेन उवाच।
              स्रष्टा धर्मस्य कश्चान्यः श्रोतव्यं कस्य वै मया। श्रुतवीर्यतपःसत्यैर्मया वा कः समो भुवि॥१२॥
verses.english: While the great sages are giving friction to the thighs of that king vena, then there emerged a blackish stocky male dwarf.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभवं सर्वभूतानां धर्माणां च विशेषतः। सम्मूढा न विदुर्नूनं भवन्तो मामचेतसः॥१३॥
verses.english: "For all the living beings, as a matter of fact, for dharma itself I am the provenance... but, you sages are fatuous to know this owing to your half-wittedness...

verses.sanskrit: इच्छन्दहेयं पृथिवीं प्लावयेयं तथा जलैः। खं भुवं चैव रुन्धेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥१४॥
verses.english: And that dwarifish person has become the initiator of the line of निषादा-s, the putative tribals, and he begot highly courageous offspring, just emerged out of the blemish of vena's enormity.

verses.sanskrit: यदा न शक्यते मोहादवलेपाच्च पार्थिवः। अनुनेतुं तदा वेनस्ततः क्रुद्धा महर्षयः॥१५॥
verses.english: And you may know that others called तुषारा-स्, तुम्बुरा-s, who took delight in अधर्म and whose abode is vindhya range, have also emerged as the posterity of vena.

verses.sanskrit: निगृह्य तं महात्मानो विस्फुरन्तं महाबलम्। ततोऽस्य सव्यमूरुं ते ममन्थुर्जातमन्यवः॥१६॥
verses.english: Then those highminded sages still becoming furious again gave friction to the right hand of vena as if it is a stick of अरणि, wooden sticks used to generate ritual fire.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु मथ्यमाने वै राज्ञ ऊरौ प्रजज्ञिवान्। ह्रस्वोऽतिमात्रः पुरुषः कृष्णश्चातिबभूव ह॥१७॥
verses.english: The, pR^ithu who is interested in the welfare of people took his bow and ran after Mother Earth.

verses.sanskrit: स भीतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा स्थितवाञ्जनमेजय। तमत्रिर्विह्वलं दृष्ट्वा निषीदेत्यब्रवीत्तदा॥१८॥
verses.english: Then that dwarf stood aside with folded palms as he is panicked, and seeing him whose eyes are blank and fidgety, sage अत्रि said to him, "sit back..."

verses.sanskrit: निषादवंशकर्तासौ बभूव वदतां वर। धीवरानसृजच्चाथ वेनकल्मषसम्भवान्॥१९॥
verses.english: And that dwarifish person has become the initiator of the line of निषादा-s, the putative tribals, and he begot highly courageous offspring, just emerged out of the blemish of vena's enormity.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये विन्ध्यनिलयास्तुषारास्तुम्बरास्तथा। अधर्मरुचयो ये च विद्धि तान्वेनसम्भवान्॥२०॥
verses.english: As soon as he got a perfect and worthy son, namely pR^ithu, then king vena is rescued from falling into a hell called पुन्नाम-नररक, to where sonless fathers are destined, and went to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनर्महात्मानः पाणिं वेनस्य दक्षिणम्। अरणीमिव संरब्धा ममन्थुस्ते महर्षयः॥२१॥
verses.english: When all the oceans and rivers have fetched and readied gems and waters from all over to anoint pR^ithu as emperor, then brahma came there along with sages, gods, and all sessile and mobile beings, and anointed that vena's son pR^ithu as the king of kings to administer kingship.
verses.bhavadeepa: तुषारास्तुम्बराश्च प्रान्तदेशीयाः म्लेच्छविशेषाः। विन्ध्यनिलयाः ‘गोण्ड’ इति ‘कोल’ इति च प्रसिद्धाः मध्यदेशीयाः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: पृथुस्तस्मात्समुत्तस्थौ कराज्ज्वलनसन्निभः। दीप्यमानः स्ववपुषा साक्षादग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥२२॥
verses.english: From that right hand of vena there emerged the highly resplendent पृथु, where his physique blazed like the blaze of ritual fire.

verses.sanskrit: स धन्वी कवची जातः पृथुरेव महायशाः। आद्यमाजगवं नाम धनुर्गृह्य महारवम्। शरांश्च दिव्यान्रक्षार्थं कवचं च महाप्रभम्॥२३॥
verses.english: That highly renowned pR^ithu emerged with bow and armour, where his bow called आजगव is highly twanging, and the armour is highly lustrous, and the divine arrows are highly protective.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिञ्जातेऽथ भूतानि सम्प्रहृष्टानि सर्वशः। समापेतुर्महाराज वेनश्च त्रिदिवं गतः॥२४॥
verses.english: Oh, king janamejaya, when pR^ithu took birth all the beings are highly rejoiced and came rushing towards him... and in the meanwhile king vena went to heaven.
verses.bhavadeepa: गृह्य गृहीत्वा रक्षार्थं प्रजानां स्थित इति शेषः॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: समुत्पन्नेन कौरव्य सत्पुत्रेण महात्मना। त्रातः स पुरुषव्याघ्र पुन्नाम्नो नरकात्तदा॥२५॥
verses.english: Sages said to those eulogists, "sing the glory of his future acts..." and pR^ithu's future acts remained just as sung by those two eulogists. The sages said this about pR^ithu's future as below:

verses.sanskrit: तं समुद्राश्च नद्यश्च रत्नान्यादाय सर्वशः। तोयानि चाभिषेकार्थं सर्व एवोपतस्थिरे॥२६॥
verses.english: During this time when an auspicious vedic ritual aiming at brahma is being conducted, there arose highminded सूत, at the time of सूति, i.e., during the time when सोम creeper is pressed for juice - सोम अभिषव काले; on the day of सौति i.e., a nominated day for pressing soma juice during the period of vedic ritual.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहश्च भगवान्देवैराङ्गिरसैः सह। स्थावराणि च भूतानि जङ्गमानि तथैव च॥२७॥
verses.english: Sages said to those eulogists, "sing the glory of his future acts..." and pR^ithu's future acts remained just as sung by those two eulogists. The sages said this about pR^ithu's future as below:

verses.sanskrit: समागम्य तदा वैन्यमभ्यषिञ्चन्नराधिपम्। महता राजराज्येन प्रजापालं महाद्युतिम् ॥२८॥
verses.english: "This king would be truthful to his word, bountiful by his will, forthright and forbearing, prosperous and victorious, conqueror as well as chastener of evildoers, diligent and scrupulous, benignant and amicable, honoured and honouring, vedic ritualist and upholder of brahma, an epitome of truth itself, calm and collective, and that king will always be engaged in his kingly activities..." So said sages to eulogists foreseeing the future of pR^ithu.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽभिषिक्तो महातेजा विधिवद्धर्मकोविदैः। आदिराज्ये तदा राज्ञां पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान्॥२९॥
verses.english: From then onwards, oh, janamejaya, whenever such praises of legitimization are to be heard, or blessings needed to be showered, then the eulogies sUtA-s and mAgadhA-s have come into vogue.

verses.sanskrit: पित्राऽपरञ्जितास्तस्य प्रजास्तेनानुरञ्जिताः। अनुरागात्ततस्तस्य नाम राजेत्यजायत॥३०॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu pleased with their eulogies bequeathed the province called अनूप to eulogist sUta, and a province called मागध to eulogist mAgadha.

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तस्तम्भिरे चास्य समुद्रमभियास्यतः। पर्वताश्च ददुर्मार्गं ध्वजभङ्गश्च नाभवत्॥३१॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu pleased with their eulogies bequeathed the province called अनूप to eulogist sUta, and a province called मागध to eulogist mAgadha.
verses.bhavadeepa: अपरञ्जिताः पीडिताः। अनुरागादिति। अनुरज्यन्तेऽस्मिन् प्रजा इति राजपदनिर्वचनं दर्शितम्॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सिध्यत्यन्नानि चिन्तया। सर्वकामदुघा गावः पुटके पुटके मधु॥३२॥
verses.english: On observing pR^ithu, the great sages have said to the people, "this king will allocate respective occupations to you all..." and then according to the saying of the sages, people rushed to pR^ithu and said, "be pleased to allocate our duties and functions ..."
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्तम्भिरे स्थलवत्कठिना बभूवुः। अभि उपरि यास्यतो गन्तुमिच्छतः ध्वजभङ्गो वृक्षाणां शाखादिभिर्गोपुरादिभिर्वा॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यज्ञे पैतामहे शुभे। सूतः सूत्यां समुत्पन्नः सौत्येऽहनि महामतिः॥३३॥
तस्मिन्नेव महायज्ञे जज्ञे प्राज्ञोऽथ मागधः। पृथोः स्तवार्थं तौ तत्र समाहूतौ सुरर्षिभिः॥३४॥
verses.english: On seeing pR^ithu running after her with bow in hand, Mother Earth took the form of a cow and fled in scare to all of the abodes of gods, like ब्रह्म लोक etc., and as none in any world could stall pR^ithu for his radiance, fierce and glowing arrows, and for his unassailability even for gods, and thus Mother Earth not getting a haven anywhere, had to return to pR^ithu alone for refuge.
verses.bhavadeepa: सूत्यां सोमाभिषवकाले अभिषवः सोमवल्ल्याः कण्डनं रसनिष्कासनार्थम्॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: तावूचुर्ऋषयः सर्वे स्तूयतामेष पार्थिवः। कर्मैस्तदनुरूपं वां पात्रं चायं नराधिपः॥३५॥
verses.english: And she who is adorable to all the three worlds, that Mother Earth stood nearby him with adjoined palms and said to pR^ithu, "won't you anticipate sin in killing a female... oh, king, how do you sustain people without me... you should know that the perish of kings and people is included in my perish... hence, you are not supposed to eliminate me if you desire welfare of your subjects...
verses.bhavadeepa: अन्यत्र तु वैन्यस्यैव यज्ञेऽग्निकुण्डात्सूतमागधौ जातावित्युक्तम्। तत्कल्पभेदात्समाधेयम्॥३४॥

verses.sanskrit: तावूचतुस्तदा सर्वांस्तान्सूतमागधौ। आवां देवानृषींश्चैव प्रीणयावः स्वकर्मभिः॥३६॥
verses.english: "Oh, king, listen to my words, everything is achievable if you make haste upon your endeavour... hence, firstly seek out an idea with which you can sustain these people... I will be obliging if you leave off your fury ... killing even mammalian females is a sin... even if it is so, it will not be apt of you to forsake dharma in killing a harmless cow like me..." So said the cow-like Mother Earth to king pR^ithu.

verses.sanskrit: न चास्य विद्वो वै कर्म न तथा लक्षणं यशः। स्तोत्रं येनास्य कुर्याव राज्ञस्तेजस्विनो द्विजाः॥३७॥
verses.english: On listening to various arguments of Mother Earth in the form of cow, that highminded pR^ithu restrained his anger and spoke to her in this way.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिस्तौ नियुक्तौ च भविष्यैः स्तूयतामिति। यानि कर्माणि कृतवान्पृथुः पश्चान्महाबलः॥३८॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fifth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the legend of emperor pR^ithu and his father vena.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवाग्दानशीलोऽयं सत्यसन्धो नरेश्वरः। श्रीमाञ्जैत्रः क्षमाशीलो विक्रान्तो दुष्टशासनः॥३९॥
verses.english: Once there was a prajApati named अन्ग, who emerged in the dynasty of sage अत्रि and who is a protector of dharma. That अन्ग is a co-equal of sage atri in virtue.
verses.bhavadeepa: पश्चात्पूर्वस्मिन् कल्पे यानि कृतवान् तैरेव अस्मिन् कल्पे भविष्यैः कर्मभिः स्तूयतामिति योजना। प्रतिकल्पं समाननामरूपायः एव सृष्टेः। “सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत्” इति श्रवणात्॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च दयावान्प्रियभाषणः। मान्यो मानयिता यज्वा ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यसङ्गरः॥४०॥
शमः शान्तश्च निरतो व्यवहारस्थितो नृपः। ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु स्तवेषु जनमेजय। आशीर्वादाः प्रयुज्यन्ते सूतमागधबन्दिभिः॥४१॥
तयोः स्तवैस्तैः सुप्रीतः पृथुः प्रादात्प्रजेश्वरः। अनूपदेशं सूताय मगधान्मागधाय च॥४२॥
तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीताः प्रजाः प्राहुर्महर्षयः। वृत्तीनामेष वो दाता भविष्यति जनेश्वरः॥४३॥
ततो वैन्यं महाराज प्रजाः समभिदुद्रुवुः। त्वं नो वृत्तिं विधत्स्वेति महर्षिवचनात्तदा॥४४॥
सोऽभिद्रुतः प्रजाभिस्तु प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया। धनुर्गृह्य पृषत्कांश्च पृथिवीमार्द्दयद्बली॥४५॥
ततो वैन्यभयत्रस्ता गौर्भूत्वा प्राद्रवन्मही। तां पृथुर्धनुरादाय द्रवन्तीमन्वधावत॥४६॥
सा लोकान्ब्रह्मलोकादीन्गत्वा वैन्यभयात्तदा। प्रददर्शाग्रतो वैन्यं प्रगृहीतशरासनम्॥४८॥
ज्वलद्भिर्निशितैर्बाणैर्दीप्ततेजसमच्युतम्। महायोगं महात्मानं दुर्धर्षममरैरपि॥४८॥
अलभन्ती तु सा त्राणं वैन्यमेवान्वपद्यत। कृताञ्जलिपुटा भूत्वा पूज्या लोकैस्त्रिभिः सदा॥४९॥
उवाच वैन्यं नाधर्म्यं स्त्रीवधं कर्तुमर्हसि। कथं धारयिता चासि प्रजा राजन् विना मया॥५०॥
मयि लोकाः स्थिता राजन् मयेदं धार्यते जगत्। मद्विनाशे विनश्येयुः प्रजाः पार्थिव विद्धि तत्॥५१॥
न त्वमर्हसि मां हन्तुं श्रेयश्चेत्त्वं चिकीर्षसि। प्रजानां पृथिवीपाल शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥५२॥
उपायतः समारब्धाः सर्वे सिध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः। उपायं पश्य येन त्वं धारयेथाः प्रजा नृप॥५३॥
हत्वापि मां न शक्तस्त्वं प्रजा धारयितुं नृप। अनुभूता भविष्यामि यच्छ कोपं महाद्युते॥५४॥
अवध्याश्च स्त्रियः प्राहुस्तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्वपि। सत्त्वेषु पृथिवीपाल न धर्मं त्यक्तुमर्हसि॥५५॥
एवं बहुविधं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा राजा महामनाः। कोपं निगृह्य धर्मात्मा वसुधामिदमब्रवीत्॥५६॥
